summary.headline: Planetary Significations and Conjunctions
summary.text: Catalog of Angelican Codex 2 entries 266–284, covering planetary terms, depressions and exaltations, nodes, rising, setting, retrogradation, direct motion, planetary conjunctions, timing of significations, burning stars, and lunar applications to the planets. Authorities and cross-references include Stephanus of Alexandria, Apomasar, and the Venetian and Vindobonensis codices.
